Welcome to British Airways

We use cookies and similar technologies. Some are essential to make our applications work or provide services which you request or expect. We'd also like to use optional cookies to improve your experience, analyse how our site is used, personalise content, show relevant ads and enable social media features. You can decide which optional cookies you allow now, or you can change those choices at any time. Find out more by reading our Cookie Policy.

Information about cookies

Manage your privacy preferences

We use some cookies that are essential for our websites to work; these are always active. We’d also like to use some optional cookies, and technologies that have a similar effect to cookies. We use these for the four purposes listed below.

We also share information about how you use our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners. These partners may combine this with other information that you’ve provided to them, or that they’ve collected from your use of their services.

You can enable or disable each optional purpose by checking or un-checking the related boxes. You can see more information about each purpose by clicking on the arrow >. When you are done, Save your preferences.

If you choose Reject all, we will just use the cookies that are necessary for the site to work. By choosing Accept all, you agree to allowing us and our partners to use cookies and other technologies for all the purposes listed.

Information about cookies

See our Privacy Policy

Essential

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for our the website to function. These cookies enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You may disable these by changing your browser settings, but this may affect how the website functions. Our website can’t operate properly without these cookies.

Analytics/Performance

These cookies make it possible to monitor and analyse user behavior, to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve our Sites, including assessing the impact of advertisements on our Sites. The information collected through this type of cookie is used to measure the activity of our Sites in order to make improvements based on the analysis of the data on the use made by users of the service. You can accept or reject the installation of these cookies.

Functional

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Marketing/Targeting

Targeting cookies are used to identify visitors across different websites. They may be set through our site by our advertising partners. These cookies may be used to build a profile of your interests and/or show relevant advertisements when browsing other websites. These cookies and any collected personal data are used for personalized advertising. If you reject these cookies, you will experience fewer targeted advertisements.
